ValidationRule.description: Nationality and UAE Resident are mandatory before converting the Lead.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( IsConverted,
OR( CONTAINS($UserRole.DeveloperName, 'Sales_Associate'), CONTAINS($UserRole.DeveloperName, 'Senior_Operations_Associate'), CONTAINS($UserRole.DeveloperName, 'Sales_Manager'), CONTAINS($UserRole.DeveloperName, 'Sales_Director') ),
NOT(ISPICKVAL(Source_Entity__c, "Modon - Egypt")),
OR( ISBLANK(TEXT(Nationality__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(UAEResidentStatus__c)) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Nationality and UAE Resident are mandatory before converting the Lead.
